goal.align.claim: Level completes when the key(plug) colored bar aligns with the matching colored segment in the adjacent black wall.

goal.align2.claim: Clear when each floating key bar aligns row-wise with matching colored wall segment.

goal.lvl6.claim: Yellow key must sit in upper-middle region with UM water level 24 so its bar cols 48-49 align with yellow segment in horizontal wall rows30-32.

mech.buttons.claim: Clicking a blue block adjacent to a black wall shifts the two gray/white sections flanking that wall by +-4 in opposite directions; blue in section S shrinks S, grows the other. Sections clamp at board/wall limits.

mech.lvl6.claim: Gravity LEFT. Regions UL(rows1-29,cols0-20) UM(rows1-29,cols24-63) L(rows33-63). Buttons:(28,1)->UL,(34,1)->L,(28,25)->UM,(34,25)->L, each moves 3 cols.

mech.water.claim: Vertical pools: click blue at a wall side moves 2 water rows from far pool into clicked pool; blocked if src empty or dest exceeds min(adj wall top). Key floats at water_top-1.
